item.text: [{"task_id":"696d4842","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    one = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    minimum_size = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    directions = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['neighbors']]","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    seen = set()","    components = []","    for r in range(h):","        for c in range(w):","            if grid[r, c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:","                continue","            color = int(grid[r, c])","            cells = [(r, c)]","            seen.add((r, c))","            for a, b in cells:","                for dr, dc in directions:","                    x, y = a + dr, b + dc","                    if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and (x, y) not in seen and grid[x, y] == color:","                        seen.add((x, y))","                        cells.append((x, y))","            components.append((color, cells))","    markers = {}","    for color, cells in components:","        if len(cells) == one:","            markers[cells[0]] = color","    for color, cells in components:","        if len(cells) < minimum_size:","            continue","        occupied = set(cells)","        endpoints = []","        for a, b in cells:","            adjacent = []","            for dr, dc in directions:","                p = (a + dr, b + dc)","                if p in occupied:","                    adjacent.append(p)","            if len(adjacent) == one and adjacent:","                endpoints.append(((a, b), adjacent[0]))","        for endpoint, neighbor in endpoints:","            dr = endpoint[0] -
